Use case: illustration-story. One finished landscape 3:2 full-bleed picture-book illustration, one coherent scene and moment, no panels or contact sheet. Bold clean clear 2D children's cartoon throughout, crisp continuous dark outlines, flat clean colors, restrained smooth cel shading, no painted or grainy texture, no gouache, no embossed relief, no 3D. Original friendly readable illustration. Ordinary neutral settings; no flags, religious/political symbols or costumes. No logos, text, letters, numbers, pseudo-writing, captions, watermarks or page borders. Natural anatomy and coherent hand/prop contact. Essential content at least 8 percent inside every edge.
 No named child cast: Kit and Zoe MUST NOT appear. Include unnamed human workers/adults ONLY when explicitly required by this particular scene; otherwise show only the natural subjects. Preserve exact reference identity and clothing.
Book: The Moon Has Not Shrunk; World Discovery; nonfiction.
Setting: Diagrammatic space views of Sun, Earth and Moon, then Earth-sky views across the lunar month. Distances and sizes explicitly simplified; no named characters.
Design locks for the book's recurring subjects/props (NOT a visibility list; never insert later objects/states prematurely): Round gray Moon; Sun outside or at far left; Blue Earth; Consistently lit lunar hemisphere; Thin crescent and full-disk sky views
 Input references lock identity, prop design and location; compose a NEW image for the exact scene, never reproduce the reference-board layout. The reference and overall prop list may contain finished objects and later story events: these are DESIGN REFERENCES ONLY, not permission to show them now. Show only the people, objects and development stage required below.
Page 10. Printed prose (NOT text to put in art): These changing views are called phases. Earth’s shadow makes a lunar eclipse, a different event. Ordinary phases come from our changing viewpoint.
Required illustration: Space view shows Sun direction, Earth and Moon off exact alignment, with a clear sightline toward partly illuminated Moon. Exact continuity: No eclipse shown; whole sphere and sunlit half remain; final diagram reinforces viewpoint, not shadow covering.
Exact current state: No eclipse shown; whole sphere and sunlit half remain; final diagram reinforces viewpoint, not shadow covering.
Do not add later events, duplicate props or a separate inset. No written title; the app renders live text.
FINAL OVERRIDE: Absolutely no humans or namedcast inthisbook. One exactscene, notrefboard. Boldclean2D cartoon, strongcontinuousdarkoutlines, smoothflatcolors and simplecelshadows, no brushtexture orgrain. No textlogosnumbers, panels or decorativearrows. ONE EarthLOWERRIGHT andoneMoonUPPERLEFT inblackspace, incominglightfromfarLEFT. BothLEFT50percentlit RIGHT50percentdark, MoonEarthanglesdiagonal, noalignment/eclipse. Showgentleparallel lightbands fromleft onlyifneeded; no arrows/labels orghosts.

Both bodies EXACTLY LEFT50% bright and RIGHT50%dark, straight vertical center terminators. No eclipse or shadows cast between bodies.
